exercises.why: **дошло** — дойти́ (perfective): to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; to come down to; (prices) to rise, to run up to, to amount to; (vulgar) to ejaculate, to cum. Wiktionary: до- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I'm at the end of my rope.
exercises.why: **дошёл** — дойти́ (perfective): to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; to come down to; (prices) to rise, to run up to, to amount to; (vulgar) to ejaculate, to cum. Wiktionary: до- + -йти́.

exercises.why: **достал** — доста́ть (perfective): to reach, to touch; to take, to go fetch, to take out; to get, to procure, to obtain; especially about a product that is rare, or of which there is a shortage; (colloquial) to annoy someone badly. Wiktionary: до- + стать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: дойти́ — to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; доста́ть — to reach, to touch; дости́гнуть — to reach, to arrive at; дово́льный — content, satisfied, pleased.

**достал** — доста́ть (perfective): to reach, to touch; to take, to go fetch, to take out; to get, to procure, to obtain; especially about a product that is rare, or of which there is a shortage; (colloquial) to annoy someone badly. Wiktionary: до- + стать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion)
to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: доказа́ть — to prove, to demonstrate; догада́ться — to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion); доба́вить — to add; доста́вить — to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish.
**доставлю** — доста́вить (perfective): to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish; to procure, to cause, to give; to give, to provide, to afford. Wiktionary: до- + ста́вить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into)
to await, to wait (un)till, to (manage to) wait for a long time
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: довести́ — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); дожида́ться — to await, to wait (un)till, to (manage to) wait for a long time; оста́ться — to remain, to stay; о́браз — shape, form.
